source_clarification.copy:
Yep, SSH from the tablet to another machine :-) A graphical client/terminal, not adding an SSH server to the tablet.

And fair point about the source link. It was buried under "project package", my bad. Here it is:
https://paperdesk.lukaszbabut.info/download/paperdesk-sources-3.0.3.tar.gz

QML/C++, installers and tests; the prebuilt ARM files are in the same archive. I've made the source buttons more obvious on the site too. Thanks for pointing it out :-)

discord.copy:
Hi :-) I got a bit carried away with my reMarkable 2 and ended up vibe-coding seven apps for it. It's called PaperDesk :-D

SSH, Web, RDP, RSS, Books (free books and papers), Dots (a little pen-and-paper game) and Care for updates. Free and open source. Version 3.0.3 is out now, with fixes for RDP landscape and the system keyboard.

Source + prebuilt ARM files, screenshots and the manual USB/SSH guide:
https://paperdesk.lukaszbabut.info/

It's unofficial and only tested on rM2 / OS 3.29.0.149. XOVI and AppLoad need to be working first. Please check the prerequisites and back up. XOVI boot autostart is off.

I'd love to know what works for you, what breaks, and which bits of the installation guide make no sense outside my own setup :-)

reddit_published_copy:
Small update: PaperDesk 3.0.3 is out :-) In v3 I also vibe-coded Dots (a simple pen-and-paper game) and Books (download public-domain titles). The latest fix is RDP landscape + the system keyboard.

The site has source + prebuilt ARM files and a manual USB/SSH installation guide. No Windows EXE needed. XOVI boot autostart stays off.

Anyone here using XOVI/AppLoad on an rM2 and willing to give it a go? I'd love to know if the guide makes sense outside my own setup :-D Tested on OS 3.29.0.149 only - check the requirements and back up first.

https://paperdesk.lukaszbabut.info/
reddit_update: A little PaperDesk update :-) Version 3.0.3 is out: seven free, open-source apps for reMarkable 2 — SSH, Web, RDP, RSS, Books, Dots and Care. The latest update fixes RDP landscape controls and the native keyboard. Thanks for the feedback here, especially on startup/recovery: the installer no longer enables XOVI at boot. Installation is manual over SSH from the project package (source + prepared ARM files, no Windows EXE needed). This is unofficial software for experienced users; tested on rM2 / OS 3.29.0.149, and other configurations aren't validated. Back up first and read the prerequisites/recovery notes. I'd love a few independent testers on the supported setup — especially feedback on where the installation guide is confusing. https://paperdesk.lukaszbabut.info/
discord_introduction: Hi! I'm building PaperDesk, a free/open-source suite for reMarkable 2: SSH, Web, RDP, RSS, Books, Dots and Care. I'm looking for experienced users to review the documented install and compatibility assumptions, not to try it blindly. Tested setup: rM2 / OS 3.29.0.149 / XOVI 0.3.3 / AppLoad 0.6.0 / LiTerm 0.1.7. The installer does not enable XOVI boot autostart. Source + prepared ARM files and a manual SSH guide: https://paperdesk.lukaszbabut.info/ . Is there an appropriate channel for a short demo and tester feedback?

outreach_subject: PaperDesk: seven free open-source apps for reMarkable 2
outreach_body: Hi! I built PaperDesk for my reMarkable 2: SSH, remote desktop, reader-first Web, RSS, Books, a Dots game and an update app. It's free/open-source community software, with manual installation over SSH. I thought the practical on-device workflows might interest your audience. Here's the project, screenshots and compatibility/recovery notes: https://paperdesk.lukaszbabut.info/ . It is currently tested on rM2 / OS 3.29.0.149; other configurations are not validated. Happy to answer technical questions. This isn't a sponsored pitch and there's no expectation of positive coverage. Thanks, Lukasz
